name: Nullform
description: Nullform is a NMDA receptor antagonist and proprioceptive suppressor derived from adapted veterinary dissociatives, modified by Shelf chemists to include an SNT-interface dampener that mutes chrome feedback signals. The result is complete disconnection from bodily sensation and physical identity — users describe existing as pure thought, untethered from flesh and metal alike.
effects: Complete proprioceptive dissociation — no sense of body, chrome, or physical location
Ego dissolution without loss of cognitive function
Profound peace for heavily augmented users no longer feeling the weight of their chrome
Dreamlike visual field that persists behind closed eyes
Time dilation — minutes feel like hours of quiet
side_effects: Physical incapacitation — users cannot operate their bodies during peak effect
Chrome systems may enter failsafe modes, causing pain or malfunction upon return
Psychological dependency in users with body dysmorphia related to augmentation
Risk of aspiration, injury, or exploitation during the incapacitation window
Comedown: sudden violent return of all suppressed physical sensation, including chronic pain
cultural_context: Nullform is the drug of the over-chromed and the body-dysphoric — Shelf residents who took military surplus augmentation to survive and now live in bodies that feel alien. 'Going Ghost' is how Tier 1 chrome-heavy workers cope with the disconnect between who they were and what they've become. There's no judgment in it. There's also no way out of the dependency loop it creates. Harm reduction workers on the Shelf consider it one of their most intractable challenges.
story_hooks: A contact the party relies on has gone Ghost and doesn't come back — they're found alive but the dose was wrong and they're trapped in dissociation, unable to interface with their own body
Someone is selling Nullform cut with a compound that doesn't just suppress chrome feedback — it overwrites it, allowing remote access to the user's augmentations while they're under
A Shelf community leader is secretly a heavy Nullform user; when this becomes known, the community fractures between those who understand and those who feel betrayed
